Add charcoal high-waisted trousers and weathered dark ankle boots. The adult stands naturally beside a waist-high brass carriage holding a large segmented Fresnel lens, one hand firmly turning its handwheel and the other lightly bracing the circular frame, with both hands anatomically clear. A hard low sunrise beam enters through a narrow high east-facing window at upper left, passes through the visibly illuminated Fresnel lens, then through a clearly visible perforated brass safety screen. It creates one broad diagonal rainbow-tinted oval lattice as the unmistakable first-read event. Across the apparatus and every receiving plane, one coherent directional source defines the shadow direction across the entire connected scene. An identifiable leaf or slat occluder grammar shapes the cast pattern throughout the room, here realized by the screen's repeating oval lattice. Show that same projection beginning on the curved aged off-white glazed-tile wall, bending and compressing with the wall, then crossing the adult through aligned colored openings and dark oval interruptions over hair, one cheek, collarbone, blouse, forearm, and wheel hand. Continue it over the near edge of the brass carriage and stretch it in perspective across a shallow rainwater film on the gray stone floor toward lower right. The pattern bends with surface curvature and depth as spacing and scale change coherently. The same cast pattern continues across two connected receiver regions within one photograph. Maintain one projection direction, repeating oval rhythm, and consistent spectral order while its geometry conforms to wall, face, fabric, metal, and wet floor; opaque occlusions interrupt it naturally. Keep the illuminated window, lens segments, screen, wall segment, adult, handwheel, and floor continuation visible together. Frame from waist height with a full-frame 35 mm viewpoint about 2.8 meters away, slightly right of the optical axis with a gentle downward tilt, a three-quarter-length adult slightly right of center, the apparatus in the upper-left third, and broad wet floor in the lower-right foreground. Use moderate depth of field around f/5.6. Balance hard warm refracted sunrise against cool blue-gray room ambience about two stops darker. Keep the post-rain air optically clear; a barely perceptible sea breeze moves only a few loose hair strands. Give the brightest window edge faint film halation while retaining crisp lattice edges. Preserve realistic skin, matte fabric, curved tile, tarnished brass, salt residue, damp footprints, coherent shadow direction, gentle highlight rolloff, restrained spectral color, and fine 35 mm color-negative grain. The photograph has quiet cinematic documentary realism with restrained fashion-editorial precision.
